comparisons.interpretation: Fateh proposes a state assistance fund for housing emergencies; Hayden calls for a pandemic rent-and-mortgage payment moratorium. Both seek to keep residents housed. The tools can complement one another, and this pair does not establish identical broader platforms or opposition to the other's measure.
